test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing the north. Only 7 persons sit between F and U. F is at one of the extreme ends of the row. Only 9 persons sit between H and U. Only 12 persons sit between E and H. E is at the extreme right end. H is at the 19th position from the extreme left end. H is 14th from the extreme right end. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
Given: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing the north.

1. H is at the 19th position from the extreme left end.

2. H is 14th from the extreme right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cee4485b0e4dd00db6798263be9d43e5284f7ec2fab7b8216b38a778a7cb60c.png] 

3. Only 12 persons sit between E and H.

4. E is at the extreme right end.

5. F is at one of the extreme ends of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bf44d3596ba039209c86a76a53a93857b2935a21a4700d422fc6c47dbc60131.png] 

6. Only 7 persons sit between F and U. 

7. Only 9 persons sit between H and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e1ddfdccbc14165a11805dc557772f1458fb5c95a86e933dc00187f96026479.png] 

So, **'32'** persons are sitting in a row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
